segments.name: OEM
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes engineered components for OEMs in the RV, transportation, marine, and housing markets.
segments.evidence: Our OEM Segment services leading OEMs in the RV, transportation, marine, and housing markets.

segments.name: Aftermarket
segments.description: Supplies accessories, replacement parts, and upgrades for RV, transportation, marine, and automotive markets through dealers, distributors, service centers, and online.
segments.evidence: Our Aftermarket Segment enhances the product lifecycle for the RV, transportation, marine, and automotive markets by offering discretionary accessories, replacement parts, and upgrades.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by RV, transportation, marine, and housing OEMs for engineered components, and by aftermarket customers—retail dealers, wholesale distributors, service centers, and direct-to-consumer online buyers—for accessories, replacement parts, and upgrades.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to serving original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs"), we also cater to aftermarket needs, selling through retail dealers, wholesale distributors, and service centers, as well as direct-to-consumer sales through online platforms.
